title: French Country Pasta
description: A hearty, comforting pasta dish inspired by the French countryside. This recipe combines the rich flavors of homestyle pasta with the freshness of Mediterranean herbs.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped parsley and dried oregano to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the garlic and herb mixture.
Toss the pasta with the garlic and herb mixture until well combined.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated parmesan cheese.
